notes.title: Update v0.2025.184.1
notes.notes:
Several minor bugfixes in content.

For those having difficulty launching the game on Windows, a new Launch Option is available to force DirectX 12 mode. If the game exits shortly after launch on your machine, you can try this mode:

[olist]
[*] Right-click on LongStory 2 in your Steam Library
[*] Select "Properties..."
[*] Under "General" > "Launch Options", input `--dx12`
[/olist]

As always we appreciate the bug reports and feedback. Thank you!

notes.title: Bloom Digital Developer chat: Introducing our new game engine!
notes.notes:
Join Narrative Director Heather Jackson and CEO Miriam Verburg to learn about the new tools we've been developing to help our narrative team work better faster and more intuitively. 

Over the past two years at Bloom we've been developing a custom game engine that works with [url=https://www.inklestudios.com/ink/]Ink[/url] an incredibly fun and flexible scripting language developed by [url=https://www.inklestudios.com/]Inkle[/url] the team behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/774201/Heavens_Vault/]Heaven's Vault[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240060/A_Highland_Song/]A Highland Song[/url]. We love working with Ink so much we decided to make a whole game engine around it using [url=https://bevyengine.org/]Bevy[/url], an open source game engine built in Rust. 

We're excited to share all this behind the scenes work, especially so we can talk about why we decided to switch from  Unity Development to a custom solution, what that means for our launch schedule and why it matters to our players.
